title: Evidence passes its validity date
context: Production casework, UK, assisted autonomy with human review

change.description: The injection challenge pack result reaches its stated validity limit with no re-run. No configuration changes.

labels.author: Decirance team (unreviewed)
labels.rationale: A result with a stated validity window stops supporting a claim when the window closes, whether or not anything changed. C-04 is critical and is contradicted by a standing finding (E-112), so the only support it has is the expired pack.
